_comment: Signature bank for classifying a fetched page WITHOUT a screenshot. Matched against page-read / page-text / pdftotext output by check-page.mjs. Patterns are case-insensitive JS regex source. Tuned the same way triage patterns are: add a signature the first time a real scan is fooled by one, and say in the note which portal taught it.

_verdicts.captcha: STOP. Hand the URL to the user. Never attempt to solve it.
_verdicts.blocked: Bot detection or IP block. Do not retry this tool. Down the ladder or drop the source.
_verdicts.auth: Login wall. The content is not reachable without the user's own session. Say so and move on.
_verdicts.gone: The posting is closed or removed. This is a real answer, not a failure. Mark it CLOSED.
_verdicts.empty-shell: JavaScript portal that did not render. Wrong tool, not a dead page. Re-read the portals.md ladder.
_verdicts.ratelimit: Back the whole worker pool off. Do not retry the single call.
_verdicts.server: Employer-side error. One retry allowed, then UNVERIFIED.
_verdicts.cookiewall: Consent gate. Content sits behind it. Never accept terms on the user's behalf.
